body:
Starting a review on a task in another column (e.g. Assigned) moves the task to the Needs review column, so a task under review isn't left in the work column.

For agents: the default workflow allows `review` in `assigned` and `needs_review` (specs/15-board-api.md §2–3); a `review` action today starts the run without a column move. Update spec 15 to match.
title: board: reviewing moves a task to Needs review
